methods.S0: Fixed Coverage ascending range(1,N,3), reused from C0
methods.S1: duration + debt + proxy, reused from C1
methods.S2: duration + proxy; debt component computed for trace but weight set to zero
methods.S3: duration + debt; proxy component computed for trace but weight set to zero
methods.S4: debt + proxy; duration component computed for trace but weight set to zero

allocation: A0 fixed 29 physical SCAN batches then at most five guarded physical VERIFY actions

decision_rules.DEBT: S2 fails while S3 and S4 retain S1 benefit
decision_rules.PROXY_SIGNAL: S3 fails while S2 and S4 retain S1 benefit; H-COV1 REJECT
decision_rules.DURATION_COVERAGE: S4 fails while S2 and S3 retain S1 benefit
decision_rules.TIE_BREAK_OR_COMMON_PATH: S2, S3, and S4 are all effective; H-COV1 NOT_IDENTIFIABLE_ON_CURRENT_TASK
decision_rules.FRAGILE: all ablations fail and reused S1 cannot reproduce

effectiveness_definition: At both frozen deadlines, all three runtime repeats recover at least one reference event with F1 and AnytimeAUC_F1 above S0; repeats are stability evidence, not semantic replication.
post_cycle_stop: No additional tuning or single-video physical experiment. The next research phase must use at least 3 independent videos x at least 2 queries with the selected method, Fixed Coverage, and Uniform Temporal.
